components.name: Kivrix reference code and workflows
components.notes: Desktop layout, local credential storage, update flow, release and license-review workflows reference Kivrix. Its copyright and MIT permission notice are retained.

components.name: MingCute — MyGo search icon
components.notes: MyGo ui/combobox.go attributes its search icon to MingCute; the Apache license is retained separately from MyGo’s MIT license.

components.name: Unicode CLDR 48.2.0 data
components.notes: Generated CLDR tables in MyGo i18n/tables.go and i18n/format_tables.go. Unicode’s original copyright notice is unchanged.

components.name: Unicode character data
components.notes: Unicode data referenced by text/language dependencies; snapshot retrieved 2026-11-05.

components.name: Public Suffix List data
components.notes: Windows dependency golang.org/x/net/publicsuffix embeds a list derived from revision d6c92f1bbb7433e5db7b8405c25d4035fb8ff376. The original MPL-2.0 source data is bundled in third-party-sources/public_suffix_list.dat. Generator and Go representation: https://go.googlesource.com/net/+/refs/tags/v0.62.0/publicsuffix/ . Nudilo does not modify the list. The MPL applies to this component, not Nudilo’s separate MIT code.

components.name: NSIS 3.13 Windows installer components
components.notes: Windows installers and uninstallers use NSIS; MyGo selects LZMA compression. The complete, unmodified NSIS 3.13 source is supplied in third-party-sources/nsis-3.13-source.tar.gz, including the LZMA decoder and its CPL-1.0 terms. Source: https://github.com/NSIS-Dev/nsis/tree/a4ba28e60bd9e7c271cd2bfc1558889ce3355653. These licenses apply to NSIS components, not the installed Nudilo application. Any different terms offered by Nudilo are offered by Nudilo alone, not by NSIS contributors.

components.name: Feishu/Lark Go SDK — wire protocol reference
components.notes: The SDK is not a Go dependency or bundled client. Nudilo’s small pairing adapter follows its public wire format; upstream copyright and license are retained as reference provenance.

components.name: DingTalk Stream Go SDK — protocol reference
components.notes: The SDK is not a Go dependency or bundled client. The public Stream protocol informed Nudilo’s pairing adapter; upstream copyright and license are retained as reference provenance.
